info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Delete Ecommerce Cart Remove-v1-spec
info.description: The Ecommerce Cart Removal API enables businesses to efficiently manage customer shopping carts by allowing the removal of items. This endpoint is frequently used by e-commerce platforms to enhance user experience by enabling customers to adjust their selected products seamlessly. Developers integrating this API can efficiently implement features that promote cart management and optimize purchasing processes. Typical consumers include online retailers and developers creating user-friendly checkout experiences.

delete.summary: Remove an item from the shopping cart.
delete.description: This endpoint allows you to remove a specific item from the user's shopping cart. Ensure you provide the necessary item identifier when making the request.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the item(s) to be removed from the shopping cart. It should contain the necessary identifiers for the cart and items to ensure proper removal.

200.description: Successfully removed item from the cart.

DeleteEcommerceCartRemoveRequest.description: Represents the request body for removing an item from the shopping cart.

DeleteEcommerceCartRemoveResponse_200.title: Cart Removal Response

status.description: Indicates whether the removal operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A reference number associated with the removal operation.

resultId.description: Unique identifier for the result of the removal operation.

state.description: Current state of the cart after the removal operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the removal operation in milliseconds.

message.description: An informational message regarding the removal operation.

DeleteEcommerceCartRemoveResponse_200.description: Response schema for the successful removal of an item from the cart.

AuditDetails.title: Audit Details

createdBy.description: Identifier for the user who created the removal entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the removal entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the removal operation was automated.

AuditDetails.description: Details regarding the audit of the cart removal operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time, in milliseconds, taken to process the request.
